item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a known bar magnet and an unmarked bar X. Indu holds them so the facing ends push apart.

What does this tell her about bar X?

options.A: Bar X is a magnet; only a magnet can repel another magnet.
options.B: Bar X is ordinary iron; the push apart is not needed to decide.
options.C: Bar X is a magnet because it is drawn the same shape as the known magnet.
options.D: Bar X is a magnet only if it attracts the known magnet, not if it pushes it.
